The '''Tingui-Botó''' are an Indigenous people of Brazil.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Reserva Indígena Aconã {{!}} Drupal |url=https://terrasindigenas.org.br/en/terras-indigenas/5106 |access-date=2025-04-11 |website=localhost |language=en}}</ref> In 2025, they numbered 469 people.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Tingui Botó - Povos Indígenas no Brasil |url=https://pib.socioambiental.org/pt/Povo:Tingui_Bot%C3%B3 |access-date=2025-04-11 |website=pib.socioambiental.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2007-10-13 |title=TINGUI BOTÓ :: Enciclopédia :: Povos Indígenas no Brasil :: ISA |url=http://www.socioambiental.org/pib/epi/tingui/tingui.shtm |access-date=2025-04-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071013070158/http://www.socioambiental.org/pib/epi/tingui/tingui.shtm |archive-date=13 October 2007 }}</ref>

== Language ==
The Tingui-Botó use Portuguese and [[Dzubukuá language|Dzubukuá]] today.<ref name=":0" />

== Culture ==
The Tingui-Botó practice the ''[[Toré]]'' religion and the ''ouricuri'' ritual.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ministério Publico Federal |title=Indígenas Aconã recebem FPI do São Francisco com a dança sagrada do Toré, em Traipu |url=https://www.mpf.mp.br/al/sala-de-imprensa/noticias-al/indigenas-acona-recebem-fpi-do-sao-francisco-com-a-danca-sagrada-do-tore-em-traipu |archive-url=http://web.archive.org/web/20240522154346/https://www.mpf.mp.br/al/sala-de-imprensa/noticias-al/indigenas-acona-recebem-fpi-do-sao-francisco-com-a-danca-sagrada-do-tore-em-traipu |archive-date=2024-05-22 |access-date=2025-04-11 |work=MPF |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=editorfpi |date=2024-05-10 |title=Indígenas Aconã recebem FPI AL com a dança sagrada do Toré |url=https://fpisaofrancisco.inf.br/index.php/2024/05/10/indigenas-acona-recebem-fpial/ |access-date=2025-04-11 |language=pt-BR}}</ref>
